subject: Next steps: partner-led marketplace discovery — availability windows & handoff
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit.rao@cloudforge.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@orion-systems.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: partner-led marketplace discovery — availability windows & handoff

Hi Amit / Priya —

Thanks again for a focused kickoff today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep the momentum for the CloudForge marketplace listing: 

- Goal: schedule a 60-minute partner-led technical deep-dive to align on listing requirements, integration touch points (billing, telemetry, provisioning), and rollout timeline.
- Ideal attendees: CloudForge marketplace PM, your SRE lead (orion contact), Redwood Solutions Engineer (tech lead), and one product/partnership owner.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jun 22, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Jun 23, 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00

Amit / Priya — can you confirm which window works and who from your side will own the meeting? If none of these work, please propose two alternatives and we’ll prioritize.

Next internal step: I’ll hand off to Sergio (Solutions Eng) for the technical agenda and demo materials; Lauren will coordinate commercial/marketplace intake items and any legal procurement checkpoints.

Attaching a short agenda and intake checklist to help prep.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Partnerships | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Attachment: Redwood-Demo-Agenda.pdf
From: Amit Rao <amit.rao@cloudforge.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@orion-systems.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: partner-led marketplace discovery — availability windows & handoff

Camila —

Appreciate the clear recap. Wed Jun 23 09:00–10:00 PST works best for CloudForge and I’ll invite our marketplace PM (Sara Lind) and Commerce integration lead (Jorge Velasquez). Priya from Orion confirmed she can do the 9:00 slot too.

We’d like to make the session primarily technical with a 15-minute slot at the end for commercial intake questions.

I’ll create a calendar invite once you confirm the attendee list from Redwood and share our internal integration doc ahead of time.

Amit
Dir. Partnerships — CloudForge
amit.rao@cloudforge.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: partner-led marketplace discovery — availability windows & handoff

Perfect — thanks Amit, Priya.

Camila / Lauren: I’ll own the technical deep-dive on the Redwood side. Agenda I’ll cover:
- 10 min: introductions and architecture context (who’s owning what)
- 20 min: demo of the Dedicated integration path + payload schemas
- 15 min: telemetry/observability and SSO/credentials flow for marketplace listings
- 15 min: open Q&A and next tasks (integration owner, sample data, timelines)

Camila — please confirm the Redwood attendee list you want me to expect. I will attach the demo checklist (MVP handoff) and a small diagram if helpful.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Attachment: marketplace-integration-checklist.xlsx

Redwood attendees: Camila Reyes (Partnerships), Sergio Alvarez (Solutions Eng), Lauren Bishop (Marketplace Intake / Commercial).
CloudForge attendees: Amit Rao (Dir. Partnerships), Sara Lind (Marketplace PM), Jorge Velasquez (Commerce Lead).
Orion attendees: Priya Menon (Partner Lead).

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-cloudforge-demo-20270623
